resources.string: We count how many devices use JellyCast, per country, to keep it free. Without your name or what you watch.
When you open the app, it sends a random number made for this app, your country and the hour. Not your name, your server or what you watch.
For support it also sends the kind of device, its system version and the app version, such as “%1$s”. Not the name of your device.
The country comes from your internet address, which is never stored.
The details are deleted after 13 months.
You can change this any time in Settings.
Counts this device per country, so JellyCast can find advertisers and stay free.
JellyCast chooses ads by country only, never by what you watch. You see this one because you\'re in %1$s.
